verses.en: The LORD’s word which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.
verses.zh: 当犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚在位的时候，耶和华的话临到希西家的玄孙，亚玛利雅的曾孙，基大利的孙子，古示的儿子西番雅。

words.g: Tsephanjah, the name of four Israelites
Cushi, the name of two Israelites
Gedaljah, the name of five Israelites
Amarjah, the name of nine Israelites
Joshijah, the name of two Israelites
Amon, the name of three Israelites
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth, says the LORD.
verses.zh: 耶和华说：我必从地上除灭万类。

verses.en: I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble with the wicked. I will cut off man from the surface of the earth, says the LORD.
verses.zh: 我必除灭人和牲畜，与空中的鸟、海里的鱼，以及绊脚石和恶人；我必将人从地上剪除。这是耶和华说的。

words.g: and + the + a stumbling-block, but only figuratively )

verses.en: I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place—the name of the idolatrous and pagan priests,
verses.zh: 我必伸手攻击犹大和耶路撒冷的一切居民，也必从这地方剪除所剩下的巴力，并基玛林的名和祭司，

words.g: and + to stretch or spread out
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
the + an ascetic , i.e. an idolatrous priest

verses.en: those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops, those who worship and swear by the LORD and also swear by Malcam,
verses.zh: 与那些在房顶上敬拜天上万象的，并那些敬拜耶和华指着他起誓，又指着玛勒堪起誓的，

words.g: to + a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar
the + to seven oneself, i.e. swear
and + the + to seven oneself, i.e. swear
in + Malcam or Milcom, the national idol of the Ammonites + +them/their

verses.en: those who have turned back from following the LORD, and those who haven’t sought the LORD nor inquired after him.
verses.zh: 与那些转去不跟从耶和华的，和不寻求耶和华也不访问他的。

words.g: the + to flinch, i.e.  to go back

verses.en: Be silent at the presence of the Lord GOD, for the day of the LORD is at hand. For the LORD has prepared a sacrifice. He has consecrated his guests.
verses.zh: 你要在主耶和华面前静默无声，因为耶和华的日子快到。耶和华已经预备祭物，将他的客分别为圣。

verses.en: It will happen in the day of the LORD’s sacrifice that I will punish the princes, the king’s sons, and all those who are clothed with foreign clothing.
verses.zh: 到了我―耶和华献祭的日子，必惩罚首领和王子，并一切穿外邦衣服的。

words.g: strange, in a variety of degrees and applications

verses.en: In that day, I will punish all those who leap over the threshold, who fill their master’s house with violence and deceit.
verses.zh: 到那日，我必惩罚一切跳过门槛、将强暴和诡诈得来之物充满主人房屋的。

words.g: the + a stretcher, i.e. a sill

verses.en: In that day, says the LORD, there will be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.
verses.zh: 耶和华说：当那日，从鱼门必发出悲哀的声音，从二城发出哀号的声音，从山间发出大破裂的响声。

words.g: the + a repetition, i.e. a duplicate

verses.en: Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan are undone! All those who were loaded with silver are cut off.
verses.zh: 玛革提施的居民哪，你们要哀号，因为迦南的商民都灭亡了！凡搬运银子的都被剪除。

verses.en: It will happen at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are settled on their dregs, who say in their heart, “The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.”
verses.zh: 那时，我必用灯巡查耶路撒冷；我必惩罚那些如酒在渣滓上澄清的；他们心里说：耶和华必不降福，也不降祸。

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
something preserved, i.e. the settlings  of wine + +them/their

verses.en: Their wealth will become a plunder, and their houses a desolation. Yes, they will build houses, but won’t inhabit them. They will plant vineyards, but won’t drink their wine.
verses.zh: 他们的财宝必成为掠物；他们的房屋必变为荒场。他们必建造房屋，却不得住在其内；栽种葡萄园，却不得喝所出的酒。

words.g: probably a force, whether of men + +them/their
and + to strike in, i.e. fix

verses.en: The great day of the LORD is near. It is near and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of the LORD. The mighty man cries there bitterly.
verses.zh: 耶和华的大日临近，临近而且甚快，乃是耶和华日子的风声；勇士必痛痛地哭号。

words.g: to be clear , i.e. to whoop

verses.en: That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,
verses.zh: 那日是忿怒的日子，是急难困苦的日子，是荒废凄凉的日子，是黑暗幽冥、密云乌黑的日子，

words.g: a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud

verses.en: a day of the trumpet and alarm against the fortified cities and against the high battlements.
verses.zh: 是吹角呐喊的日子，要攻击坚固城和高大的城楼。

words.g: and + clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry

verses.en: I will bring such distress on men that they will walk like blind men because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.
verses.zh: 我必使灾祸临到人身上，使他们行走如同瞎眼的，因为得罪了我。他们的血必倒出如灰尘；他们的肉必抛弃如粪土。

words.g: and + to cramp, literally or figuratively

verses.en: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath, but the whole land will be devoured by the fire of his jealousy; for he will make an end, yes, a terrible end, of all those who dwell in the land.
verses.zh: 当耶和华发怒的日子，他们的金银不能救他们；他的忿怒如火必烧灭全地，毁灭这地的一切居民，而且大大毁灭。

words.g: to tremble inwardly , i.e.  be   alarmed or agitated

verses.en: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, you nation that has no shame,
verses.zh: 不知羞耻的国民哪，你们应当聚集！趁命令没有发出，日子过去如风前的糠，耶和华的烈怒未临到你们，他发怒的日子未到以先，你们应当聚集前来。

words.g: to forage for straw, stubble or wood
and + to forage for straw, stubble or wood
to become pale, i.e.  to pine after

verses.en: before the appointed time when the day passes as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD comes on you, before the day of the LORD’s anger comes on you.
verses.zh: a

verses.en: Seek the LORD, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances. Seek righteousness. Seek humility. It may be that you will be hidden in the day of the LORD’s anger.
verses.zh: 世上遵守耶和华典章的谦卑人哪，你们都当寻求耶和华！当寻求公义谦卑，或者在耶和华发怒的日子可以隐藏起来。

words.g: to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: For Gaza will be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation. They will drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron will be rooted up.
verses.zh: 迦萨必致见弃；亚实基伦必然荒凉。人在正午必赶出亚实突的民；以革伦也被拔出根来。

words.g: and + Ashkelon, a place in Palestine
and + Ekron, a place in Palestine

verses.en: Woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! The LORD’s word is against you, Canaan, the land of the Philistines. I will destroy you until there is no inhabitant.
verses.zh: 住沿海之地的基利提族有祸了！迦南、非利士人之地啊，耶和华的话与你反对，说：我必毁灭你，以致无人居住。

words.g: a rope , especially a measuring line
a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth

verses.en: The sea coast will be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.
verses.zh: 沿海之地要变为草场，其上有牧人的住处和羊群的圈。

words.g: a rope , especially a measuring line

verses.en: The coast will be for the remnant of the house of Judah. They will find pasture. In the houses of Ashkelon, they will lie down in the evening, for the LORD, their God, will visit them and restore them.
verses.zh: 这地必为犹大家剩下的人所得；他们必在那里牧放群羊，晚上必躺卧在亚实基伦的房屋中；因为耶和华―他们的神必眷顾他们，使他们被掳的人归回。

words.g: a rope , especially a measuring line
to + a remainder or residual  portion
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people and magnified themselves against their border.
verses.zh: 我听见摩押人的毁谤和亚扪人的辱骂，就是毁谤我的百姓，自夸自大，侵犯他们的境界。

words.g: Moab, an incestuous son of Lot
to pull off, i.e.  to expose

verses.en: Therefore, as I live, says the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles and salt pits, and a perpetual desolation. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and the survivors of my nation will inherit them.
verses.zh: 万军之耶和华―以色列的神说：我指着我的永生起誓：摩押必像所多玛，亚扪人必像蛾摩拉，都变为刺草、盐坑、永远荒废之地。我百姓所剩下的必掳掠他们；我国中所余剩的必得着他们的地。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar
Moab, an incestuous son of Lot
like + Sedom, a place near the Dead Sea
like + Amorah, a place in Palestine
pointed, i.e. a bramble or other thorny weed
and + an overhanging, i.e.  an excess
to inherit  mode of descent), or  to occupy + +them/their

verses.en: This they will have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the LORD of Armies.
verses.zh: 这事临到他们是因他们骄傲，自夸自大，毁谤万军之耶和华的百姓。

words.g: to pull off, i.e.  to expose
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: The LORD will be awesome to them, for he will famish all the gods of the land. Men will worship him, everyone from his place, even all the shores of the nations.
verses.zh: 耶和华必向他们显可畏之威，因他必叫世上的诸神瘦弱。列国海岛的居民各在自己的地方敬拜他。

verses.en: You Cushites also, you will be killed by my sword.
verses.zh: 古实人哪，你们必被我的刀所杀。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
a Cushite, or descendant of Cush

verses.en: He will stretch out his hand against the north, destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as the wilderness.
verses.zh: 耶和华必伸手攻击北方，毁灭亚述，使尼尼微荒凉，又干旱如旷野。

words.g: and + to stretch or spread out
Ashshur, the second son of Shem

verses.en: Herds will lie down in the middle of her, all kinds of animals. Both the pelican and the porcupine will lodge in its capitals. Their calls will echo through the windows. Desolation will be in the thresholds, for he has laid bare the cedar beams.
verses.zh: 群畜，就是各国（国：或译类）的走兽必卧在其中；鹈鹕和箭猪要宿在柱顶上。在窗户内有鸣叫的声音；门槛都必毁坏，香柏木已经露出。

words.g: a species of bird, perhaps the bittern

verses.en: This is the joyous city that lived carelessly, that said in her heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a desolation, a place for animals to lie down in! Everyone who passes by her will hiss and shake their fists.
verses.zh: 这是素来欢乐安然居住的城，心里说：惟有我，除我以外再没有别的；现在何竟荒凉成为野兽躺卧之处！凡经过的人都必摇手嗤笑她。

words.g: to be shrill, i.e. to whistle or hiss
to waver, in a great variety of applications

verses.en: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!
verses.zh: 这悖逆、污秽、欺压的城有祸了！

words.g: the + to rage or be violent

verses.en: She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in the LORD. She didn’t draw near to her God.
verses.zh: 她不听从命令，不领受训诲，不倚靠耶和华，不亲近她的神。

verses.en: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.
verses.zh: 她中间的首领是咆哮的狮子；她的审判官是晚上的豺狼，一点食物也不留到早晨。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +her/its
to bone, i.e. denude  the bones

verses.en: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.
verses.zh: 她的先知是虚浮诡诈的人；她的祭司亵渎圣所，强解律法。

words.g: to bubble up or froth , i.e.  to be unimportant

verses.en: The LORD, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.
verses.zh: 耶和华在她中间是公义的，断不做非义的事，每早晨显明他的公义，无日不然；只是不义的人不知羞耻。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +her/its
to arrange as a battle, a vineyard

verses.en: I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.
verses.zh: 我―耶和华已经除灭列国的民；他们的城楼毁坏。我使他们的街道荒凉，以致无人经过；他们的城邑毁灭，以致无人，也无居民。

words.g: to stun , i.e. devastate or  stupefy
to parch  i.e.  to desolate, destroy
from + failure, i.e. nothing or destruction
from + failure, i.e. nothing or destruction

verses.en: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.
verses.zh: 我说：你只要敬畏我，领受训诲；如此，你的住处不致照我所拟定的除灭。只是你们从早起来就在一切事上败坏自己。

words.g: to load up , i.e. to start early in the morning

verses.en: “Therefore wait for me”, says the LORD, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
verses.zh: 耶和华说：你们要等候我，直到我兴起掳掠的日子；因为我已定意招聚列国，聚集列邦，将我的恼怒―就是我的烈怒都倾在她们身上。我的忿怒如火，必烧灭全地。

words.g: to + to gather for any purpose
dominion, i.e.  the estate  or  the country
strictly froth at the mouth, i.e.  fury + +me/my

verses.en: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on the LORD’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.
verses.zh: 那时，我必使万民用清洁的言语好求告我―耶和华的名，同心合意地事奉我。

words.g: the neck  as the place of burdens

verses.en: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.
verses.zh: 祈祷我的，就是我所分散的民（原文是女子；下同），必从古实河外来，给我献供物。

words.g: Cush , the name of a son of Ham
to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively + +me/my

verses.en: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.
verses.zh: 当那日，你必不因你一切得罪我的事自觉羞愧；因为那时我必从你中间除掉矜夸高傲之辈，你也不再于我的圣山狂傲。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
from + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +you/your
to + to soar, i.e. be lofty

verses.en: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in the LORD’s name.
verses.zh: 我却要在你中间留下困苦贫寒的民；他们必投靠我―耶和华的名。

words.g: and + to swell up, i.e. be  redundant
in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +you/your
and + dangling, i.e.  weak or thin

verses.en: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”
verses.zh: 以色列所剩下的人必不作罪孽，不说谎言，口中也没有诡诈的舌头；而且吃喝躺卧，无人惊吓。

words.g: in + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +them/their

verses.en: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.zh: 锡安的民哪，应当歌唱！以色列啊，应当欢呼！耶路撒冷的民哪，应当满心欢喜快乐！

words.g: and + to jump for joy, i.e. exult
Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.zh: 耶和华已经除去你的刑罚，赶出你的仇敌。以色列的王―耶和华在你中间；你必不再惧怕灾祸。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +you/your

verses.en: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”
verses.zh: 当那日，必有话向耶路撒冷说：不要惧怕！锡安哪；不要手软！

verses.en: The LORD, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
verses.zh: 耶和华―你的神是施行拯救、大有能力的主。他在你中间必因你欢欣喜乐，默然爱你，且因你喜乐而欢呼。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +you/your

to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.zh: 那些属你、为无大会愁烦、因你担当羞辱的，我必聚集他们。

verses.en: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.
verses.zh: 那时，我必罚办一切苦待你的人，又拯救你瘸腿的，聚集你被赶出的。那些在全地受羞辱的，我必使他们得称赞，有名声。

words.g: and + to be open, wide or free

verses.en: At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says the LORD.
verses.zh: 那时，我必领你们进来，聚集你们；我使你们被掳之人归回的时候，就必使你们在地上的万民中有名声，得称赞。这是耶和华说的。
